title: P0 — Engineering Book
description: First bilingual static slice of the Accelerator.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Publish theory and connect decisions to actual evidence without inventing learning levels.

sections.title: Provisional architecture
paragraphs: TypeScript and minimal static generation initialize P0. site/ is canonical; apps/book validates and renders. This is not a final framework decision. Comparing alternatives belongs to the learner.

sections.title: Implementation
paragraphs: Code: apps/book/src/. Tests: apps/book/test/. Commands: npm run check and npm run dev. The remote repository URL is not yet known; no link is invented.

sections.title: Evidence
paragraphs: No learner evidence is recorded. Record actual results in artifacts/experiments/PA-S001.md and link only reviewed public material.

sections.title: Scope and pending work
paragraphs: Includes ES/EN navigation, system color scheme, and static output. Manual theme selection, dashboard, and shared platform evolve in later sessions. The initial chapter is an editorial synthesis; Codex must expand it under the complete-theory contract.
